question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count applies to thousands of locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are said to be tormented.
inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
